name: banking_intents
instructions: A customer of a digital bank (app with physical, virtual and disposable cards, top-ups, transfers and currency exchange) sent this support-chat message. Which single intent best describes what the customer is asking about?

criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a card they have received; activation problems.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open/use an account; can children or teenagers have an account.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or Android Pay, including topping up with Apple Pay / Google Pay.
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs accept the card, where to find an ATM, using ATMs (e.g. changing PIN at an ATM).
criteria.automatic_top_up: Automatic / auto top-up: whether available, how to set up, how it works. Includes questions about limits of auto top-up. Example: "What, if any, is the limit for auto top-up?"
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Money sent by bank transfer (e.g. top-up or incoming transfer) has not appeared in their balance yet. Takes precedence over transfer_timing when a completed transfer is not showing up. Example: "How long does a transfer from the UK account usually take? After completing the transfer it is not showing up."
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A deposited cheque or cash has not shown up in their balance. Example: "the balance has not changed, but I have deposited some money"
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Unable to add a beneficiary/payee, or a transfer to a beneficiary is not allowed. Includes trouble transferring money to a beneficiary. Example: "I am having trouble transferring money to a beneficiery." Also a transaction the app won't allow: "I was trying to purchase some crypto and the app won't allow me to do it."
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel or reverse a transfer they made (e.g. sent to wrong account).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or expired; how to get a replacement for an expiring card. Includes fees for getting a new replacement card faster. Example: "Are there any express fees if i want my new card faster?"
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted; a merchant/shop won't accept the card. General questions about where the card can be used; a specific failed payment at a shop is declined_card_payment.
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card has not arrived yet; tracking the card delivery.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes; delivery timing and shipping options before it's late.
criteria.card_linking: Linking or adding a card to the app/account; re-linking a found card.
criteria.card_not_working: The card is not working in general (not specifically contactless, virtual, or ATM declines). Includes vague complaints that the card never goes through, without saying a payment was declined. Example: "What's going on with my card? I've tried multiple times and it never goes through."
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Charged a fee for a card payment/purchase. Includes general complaints about being charged unexplained fees. Example: "I am tired of getting charged fees, and I have no idea why, please let me know what/when you charge fees for."
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment on the statement they do not recognise / didn't make. Includes a generic unknown charge on the account. Example: "Why is there an uknown charge showing on my account?" Includes a payment on the statement they say is wrong. Example: "A payment on my statement is wrong."
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong or bad exchange rate applied to a card purchase/payment abroad.
criteria.card_swallowed: ATM swallowed / kept / ate the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fee charged for withdrawing cash from an ATM. Includes generic complaints about an unexpected fee they thought was free. Example: "Why did I get charged a fee, I thought it was free?"
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash/ATM withdrawal on their account they did not make. Includes unexplained cash transactions showing in the app. Example: "THere is some cash that is showing up on my app."
criteria.compromised_card: Worried card details have been compromised/hacked or used fraudulently by someone else; wants to freeze card for fraud.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service is available/supported in; using the account while living in or moving to another country.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment/purchase was declined or rejected. Includes the card not being accepted at a shop when paying. Example: "My card was not accepted in a shop"
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined/rejected. Includes messages complaining that a transfer is being denied, even if they also mention a purchase. Example: "my card keeps getting declined. Why do you keep denying my transfer?"
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit payment they do not recognise or did not set up. Includes being charged by mistake on their debit statement. Example: "I think I was charged by mistake on my debit statement."
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits/restrictions of disposable virtual cards (how many uses, amounts).
criteria.edit_personal_details: Change personal details such as name, address, phone, email.
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used, where rates come from, current rate.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange/convert currencies in the app; whether exchange is possible.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra charge (e.g. an extra £1/$1 fee) on the statement. Includes a small unknown charge/purchase (e.g. £1) they don't remember. Example: "My statement shows a 1£ purchase pending. I do not remember making this purchase"
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed or did not go through.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies can be held/exchanged/used; cryptocurrency support.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get/create a disposable virtual card.
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting the physical card, e.g. where to find the PIN for a new card, obtaining a physical card when having only a virtual one.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting additional/extra/spare cards, e.g. for a family member.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get/order a (non-disposable) virtual card; where is my virtual card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card lost or stolen. Includes wanting help retrieving their card. Example: "Can you help me retrieve my card?"
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost or stolen; access to the app without the phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: How to order a physical card, cost of a card, shipping destinations.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode/password; reset passcode.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment/purchase is showing as pending.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal is showing as pending.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is pending/still processing. Includes adding money where the transaction hasn't gone through yet. Example: "I added money to the card but the transaction didn't go through" Also: "Where are my funds? I topped off my car but it didn't seem to complete."
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked after too many wrong attempts; unblock PIN.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money/payments/salary into the account. Includes being paid a salary in a currency and how their account receives it. Example: "How do I know what my account is set to, I am paid in GBP?"
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: An expected refund from a merchant has not appeared in their account.
criteria.request_refund: Wants to request a refund or cancel a purchase to get money back. Includes how long a refund takes when they have not yet been promised one. Example: "How long does it take to get a refund on something I bought?"
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted/returned/reversed. Includes a paid purchase that has since disappeared from the account. Example: "I bought something and already paid for it but now I don't see it." Also: "Seems like my card payment has been cancelled"
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (e.g. Visa/Mastercard/Amex) and currencies are supported for top-up and payments. Includes whether a specific card brand (e.g. American Express) can be used to add money. Example: "Am I able to add money into my account using my American Express?" Also which currencies can be used to add money: "what currencies can i use to add money to my account"
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fee for topping up by bank transfer.  Includes questions about SWIFT transfers. Example: "I want to do a swift transfer"
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fee for topping up with a card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: How to top up with cash or a cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed or did not work. Includes a misspelled top-up ('pop-up') that may have failed, or money inaccessible because something is wrong with the top-up. Examples: "I'm not sure if my pop-up went through."; "I can't access my money. Is it because somethings wrong with the top-up? I set it up correctly."
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-up amounts or number of top-ups. Not about auto top-up (that is automatic_top_up).
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted/cancelled/money disappeared back after top-up.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up using a card; top-up by card issues not covered elsewhere. Includes adding money with a credit/debit card. Example: "Transferring money using credit card" Includes whether other people can top up their account. Example: "Can other people top up my account?"
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Charged a fee for a transfer. Includes fees for banking/sending money abroad. Example: "Why have I been charged a higher fee for doing banking abroad." Includes fee increases when using the account overseas. Example: "I have used this account overseas recently. Has there been an increase in fees that I am unaware of?"
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into their account (add money by transfer).
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Sent a transfer but the recipient has not received it. Includes an outgoing transfer sent days ago that has still not reached the other party. Examples: "i've waited 2 days for a transfer to reach a retailers account, am i going to have to wait longer."; "I have done a transfer within the country the day before yesterday, but it's still not there yet." Includes worry that too much time has passed for a sent transfer. Example: "I am worried that too much time has gone by for a transfer to be completed."
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive; transfer speed.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Tried but unable to complete identity verification; verification failing.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; what documents are needed.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying the source of their funds/money. Includes asking where their funds come from/flow. Example: "How can I find out where the funds are flow?" Also: "Can I see my available money?"
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification code for top-up with a card; verifying a card used for top-up. Example: "I don't see the verification code for my card transfer."
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: The virtual card is not working.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Is the card Visa or Mastercard. Includes wanting a card of a specific network. Example: "I'm wanting to get a Visa card today." Example: "Do you accept Visa or Mastercard?"
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why they need to verify their identity.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash / less cash than requested.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal abroad. Includes complaints that the rate was too high for the cash received. Example: "Why is the exchange rate so high? This should have been a much higher amount of cash for that to apply."
